$comment: Source of truth for the Cloudflare MCP portal mapping of server `api` on portal `mcp` (mctlhq/.github#35, mctlhq/mctl-api#276). Every tool this server registers must appear here with an explicit decision; internal/mcp/portal_allowlist_test.go fails the build otherwise. An enabled tool must carry a `reason` saying what it exposes or changes and why that is acceptable on a shared surface; a tool that is NOT recorded readOnly in internal/mcp/annotations_test.go may be enabled only if the mutatingOnPortal map in that test names it, which is a reviewed Go change rather than a JSON edit. readOnlyHint is a side-effect hint, not a privacy classification. Apply with scripts/portal-allowlist-apply.sh.

Enabled on the shared portal by owner decision 2026-09-12 (mctlhq/.github#35): the portal switch is user-blind, so the mctl API's own authentication, team scope and role checks are the access control -- the portal only decides visibility.
